items.title: Waldren "Frog" Joseph Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: But after the war, well, Freddie, Jack, Sam, and I, we got together. Now Bill, this may sound foolish, but before this music came back, we had this little outfit. We had six of us.

ctx.x: I don't know. Well, at that time, I think.

he was working with Sidney. But after the war, well, Freddie, Jack, Sam, and I, we got together. Now Bill, this may sound foolish, but before this music came back, we had this little outfit. We had six of us. And we used to play a lot of these New Orleans tunes. And we worked at a place they called the GI Club during the war in Omaha, Nebraska.
